title: Dennis Gustafsson – Parallelizing the physics solver – BSC 2025
summary: Dennis Gustafsson, creator of Teardown, presents how he parallelized the physics solver for an upcoming game, followed by a Q&A. The talk was given at the Better Software Conference 2025.
why: HN points to it as a practical example of solving a tricky multithreading problem, including using a spinlock to speed up a real-time physics solver.

quote.text: The following is an interesting talk where the author used a spinlock to speed up a real-time physics solver significantly.
